_doc: THE canonical runner label list. Read by runner/autoscaler/nb_autoscaler.py, scripts/ci/mini-runner-labels.sh (root repo) and tests/test_autoscaler.py. CI runs only on burst VMs. Mac Minis carry NO CI labels (pre-push gate over ssh only); macmini-preview and -2 keep aqa-coord (AutoQA coordinator, not CI) as today. The fallback runner gets ci_labels only while GCP cannot start VMs (the autoscaler adds and removes them).
